purpose: Workflow for creating requirements documents and design tokens from a Figma design file, covering design system construction, screen/component/function requirements, assets, and quality review.
summary: Required reading list: requirement principles, format, error classification, boundary, priorities, style guide
Phase 1: check Figma MCP availability, confirm with the user, fetch rules and existing specs
Phase 2: two-layer design system (design tokens and semantic themes), reusable components, token extraction
Phase 3: ID numbering and placement, SCR screen requirements with ASCII layouts and screen-specific part names
Phase 3: CMP component and FNC function requirements, complementing requirements absent from the design
Phase 4: static asset inventory and asset management policy
Phase 5: design token and requirements verification checklists
Phase 5: AI review, reference existence check placeholder, specs index update, commit confirmation
Completion guidance with the next start-design command
tasks: Creating requirements from a Figma design file
Defining screen requirements (SCR) from Figma screens
Redesign of an existing app with Figma
title: Figma 要件定義書作成ワークフロー
